kjv: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them
note: TR adds "hos de eporeuonto apangeilai tois mathetais autou"; absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, Bezae.

kjv: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations
mine: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations
note: matheteusate is "make disciples", followed by baptizing and teaching as its means; KJV's "teach" anticipates the separate verb didaskontes in 28:20.

kjv: unto the end of the world. Amen.
mine: to the end of the age
note: synteleia tou aionos is the end of the age (as at 13:39, 24:3); TR also adds a closing "amen".
